logline: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.
continuity_notes: Picks up after Episode 7, where Alexander chased off Gerald and the mocking aristocratic visitors; quiet and intimacy now return inside the woodland cottage as evening approaches.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana seated at a rustic wooden table beside a daylight-lit window, gently touching an aged leather-bound book.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Somber)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's hands carefully unlatching the metal clasp on the leather book.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana tenderly opening the cover and turning the brittle parchment pages.

segments.label: JULIANA (Reflective, Reverent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Mother spent years writing this.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander enters the dim room behind Juliana, quietly stepping up to the rustic table.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward Alexander in pleasant surprise.

segments.label: JULIANA (Curious, Recognizing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Yarrow.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander looking down at her, the firelight catching the rugged scar across his face.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Calm, Knowledgeable)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Good for wounds. Fever, too.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.

segments.label: JULIANA (Inquiring, Soft)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: How do you know that?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Matter-of-Fact)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.

segments.label: JULIANA (Observant, Lightly Teasing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You know more about healing than you let on.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Gritty)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Enough to survive.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana setting down a bunch of flowers and looking intently at his rugged visage.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Soft)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Your hair and beard...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander standing tall over her, looking down patiently.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Tender)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I could trim them for you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Firm, Low)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Not yet.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.

segments.label: JULIANA (Puzzled, Curious)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Not yet?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grounded, Steady)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Let them grow.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.

segments.label: JULIANA (Playful, Amused)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dry, Droll)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It has advantages.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fond, Resigned)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Very well.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Teasing, Determined)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Amused)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: We'll see.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Instructional, Calm)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Nostalgic)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My mother wrote the same thing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking across at his battle-marked features with empathy.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Compassionate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: And the scars... were they from the war?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander looking downward, memories clouding his eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Subdued)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Some were.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with gentle understanding.

segments.label: JULIANA (Tender, Aching)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It must have been terrible.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander lifting his gaze, heavy with past battles.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Heavy, Somber)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It was.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana smiling tenderly at him across the open book.

segments.label: JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I thought losing wealth meant losing everything.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot framing the warm silhouette of the two companions sitting peacefully beside the blazing stone hearth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's radiant face illuminated by firelight, a peaceful, contented smile spreading across her lips as she looks at him until the shot gently fades out.

segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Transformed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Perhaps I was wrong.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.
